name: Greek motorway tolls (open toll stations)
law: The concession agreements ratified by law (e.g. ν. 3559/2007 for Moreas), prices for 2026 as published by each concession company: Olympia Odos, Nea Odos, Kentriki Odos, Moreas and Aegean Motorway, and the Rio–Antirrio bridge (Gefyra, by axles). Per passage of a front or side station, category 3 (over 2.20 m, two or three axles) and 4 (four or more axles), excluding 24% VAT. Within a toll zone a trip pays one station only, as the stations are placed. Stations placed with OpenStreetMap's toll booths. Egnatia Odos: Νέα Εγνατία Οδός's station list (front stations per direction, side stations by ramp), 'Φορτηγά – Λεωφορεία' as category 3 and '4+ Άξονες' as 4. Attiki Odos: one toll per entry (Νέα Αττική Οδός, under article 18.4.1 of its concession agreement), category 5 (over 2.70 m, two or three axles) and 6 (four or more), at each of its booths: as they lie by the main carriageway, a trip pays the first it passes and no other within the hour.

sources.title: Νέα Αττική Οδός: Τιμαριθμική προσαρμογή διοδίων τελών 2026
